settings.title: Settings

monitoring.title: Monitoring guide
monitoring.description: Use this page to decide what Maekon captures and how often it samples activity.

permissions.title: Resolve desktop access first
permissions.description: Screen capture and accessibility status affect whether downstream timelines and insights are reliable.

intervals.title: Tune intervals conservatively
intervals.description: Shorter intervals create fresher metrics, but also more storage and runtime work.

privacy.title: Use privacy mode for pauses
privacy.description: Privacy mode pauses capture without forcing you to rewrite the rest of the monitoring setup.

privacy.title: Privacy guide
privacy.description: Use these controls to keep sensitive apps, titles, and identifiers out of captured context.

automatic.title: Start with automatic exclusions
automatic.description: Keep the sensitive-app detector enabled before adding manual app or title rules.

pii.title: Choose the masking level
pii.description: Use Standard for everyday capture and Strict when exported diagnostics may include paths or keys.

patterns.title: Use title patterns for sensitive workflows
patterns.description: Window-title patterns catch private documents even when the app itself is normally safe.

notifications.title: Notification guide
notifications.description: Use notifications when they create timely coaching value without becoming background noise.

permission.title: Confirm OS permission first
permission.description: If desktop notification permission is blocked, these thresholds will not produce visible reminders.

thresholds.title: Tune one threshold at a time
thresholds.description: Start with idle and long-session reminders before enabling resource warnings.

usage.title: Keep high-usage alerts rare
usage.description: Reserve CPU or memory alerts for exceptional load so they remain actionable.

dataStorage.title: Data & storage guide
dataStorage.description: Use this page to understand local footprint, export recent records, and set retention limits.

review.title: Review the footprint
review.description: Compare database, frame, event, and metric counts before changing caps.

export.title: Export before reducing retention
export.description: Export metrics, events, or frame metadata before lowering storage or retention limits.

telemetry.title: Telemetry is separate
telemetry.description: Telemetry toggles control remote diagnostics, not the local records retained on this device.

sync.title: Sync setup guide
sync.description: Sync needs matching configuration, a shared secret, and a transport that fits your devices.
sync.enabledDescription: Use this page to confirm the local device identity, discover peers, and run an explicit sync cycle.

transport.title: Choose a transport deliberately
transport.description: LAN, file, and remote sync have different privacy and reachability trade-offs.

passphrase.title: Protect the passphrase
passphrase.description: All devices must use the same secret, and losing it prevents decrypting shared state.

restart.title: Restart after config changes
restart.description: Sync configuration is read at startup, so restart after enabling or changing transport settings.

device.title: Confirm this device
device.description: Check the displayed name and truncated ID before syncing multiple machines.

peers.title: Validate peer discovery
peers.description: No peers usually means transport, network, or passphrase setup still needs attention.

conflicts.title: Review applied vs skipped
conflicts.description: Skipped changes are useful signals when two devices have divergent state.

audio.title: Audio setup guide
audio.description: Use audio capture only when speech context is worth the added permission and storage surface.

provider.title: Choose local or cloud STT
provider.description: Local Whisper keeps audio processing on-device; cloud STT requires a provider key and network egress.

model.title: Download the right model
model.description: Larger models improve transcription quality but increase disk and memory use.

input.title: Pick an input mode
input.description: Push-to-talk is predictable; voice activity needs sensitivity tuning for your room.

bystander.title: Inform people before recording
bystander.description: Tell nearby participants what will be captured and obtain consent where required before enabling audio.

advanced.title: Advanced settings guide
advanced.description: These controls affect runtime behavior across capture, analysis, networking, and sync.

runtime.title: Change runtime limits carefully
runtime.description: Session, retry, and analysis intervals can affect responsiveness and resource use.

network.title: Keep endpoints explicit
network.description: Server and gRPC endpoints should point at the intended environment before enabling remote flows.

sync.title: Pair sync settings with the sync page
sync.description: Enable sync here, then use the Sync page to verify device identity and peers.

aiAutomation.title: AI automation guide
aiAutomation.description: Use this page to choose how Maekon reaches AI tools, what data may leave the device, and which safeguards must stay active.

path.title: Pick the access path first
path.description: Choose direct endpoints, an installed provider CLI, or OAuth before tuning individual OCR and LLM fields.

safety.title: Keep safety gates visible
safety.description: Sandbox, data policy, OCR validation, and scene execution controls determine what automation is allowed to do.

verify.title: Verify before widening access
verify.description: Load models, check readiness, and save reusable profiles before enabling broader remote or execution access.

aiAutomation.footer: Use Execution History and Execution Policies after saving to confirm the runtime behaves as intended.

trackingSchedule.title: Tracking schedule guide
trackingSchedule.description: Use schedules when capture should follow predictable work windows instead of running all day.

windows.title: Add clear windows
windows.description: Use non-overlapping start and end times with labels that match the intended routine.

timezone.title: Confirm timezone
timezone.description: Use Local for this machine or an explicit IANA zone when matching another location.

status.title: Check active-now status
status.description: The status pill confirms whether the saved schedule is currently allowing capture.

memoryVault.sectionDescription: Mirror your daily digests and current claims into plain Markdown files you can open in Obsidian or any editor.
memoryVault.oneWayNotice: This is a one-way mirror. Maekon writes these files and never reads their content back, so any edits you make to a generated file are overwritten when it regenerates. Copy a file out of the vault if you want to keep your own version.
memoryVault.enableHint: Grants the dedicated memory-vault permission and starts writing files after each daily digest. Off by default.
memoryVault.consentPending: The mirror is switched on in settings but the memory-vault permission is not currently valid, so no files are being written. Toggle it off and on again to re-grant.
memoryVault.windowOutOfBound: The mirror window ({{days}} days) is outside its allowed range, so every cycle does nothing — no files are written and none are deleted. Lower the window to at most your retention period.
memoryVault.pathUnresolved: Could not resolve a vault folder on this device.
memoryVault.defaultPathNote: This is the app-owned default folder. It is local to this device and not inside any cloud-sync folder.
memoryVault.pendingPathNote: {{path}} is configured but has not been acknowledged, so the mirror is still using the default folder. Enter it again below to review the risks and confirm.
memoryVault.cloudActiveNotice: This folder is inside {{provider}}. Every cycle that writes a file records one entry in the egress ledger.
memoryVault.warningOverwrite: Files in that folder matching the vault's naming pattern will be overwritten or deleted without merging. Files Maekon did not generate are left untouched — it only rewrites files that carry its own header line.
memoryVault.warningSyncDetected: This folder is inside {{provider}}. Your claim text will leave this device continuously through that service. Maekon cannot detect every sync mechanism, so a custom folder is your responsibility.
memoryVault.warningSyncUnknown: Maekon did not recognize a cloud service for this folder, but it cannot detect every sync mechanism. If any sync tool you run covers this folder, your claim text will leave this device through it. A custom folder is your responsibility.
memoryVault.warningAcknowledge: I understand that files may be overwritten and that claim text may leave this device.
memoryVault.pathCleared: Back to the default vault folder.
memoryVault.exportNowHint: Runs one full mirror cycle immediately: refreshes day files, rewrites the claims file, and removes files outside the window.
memoryVault.exportDone: Mirror complete. {{days}} day file(s) written, {{expired}} expired file(s) removed.
memoryVault.exportSkipped: Mirror did nothing ({{reason}}). No files were written or deleted.
memoryVault.conflictsNotice: {{count}} file(s) were skipped because Maekon did not generate them. Rename or move them if you want the vault to use those names.
memoryVault.lastCycleNever: The mirror has not run yet. It runs automatically after each daily digest once it is switched on.
memoryVault.lastCycleSummary: {{time}} — {{days}} day file(s) written, {{expired}} expired file(s) removed.
memoryVault.conflictsTitle: {{count}} file(s) were skipped and left exactly as they are.
memoryVault.conflictsExplain: These names match the ones the vault uses, but Maekon did not generate the files, so it skipped them instead of overwriting them. Nothing was changed or deleted. Move or rename a file if you want the mirror to own that name.

claims.title: Memory claims
claims.description: A read-only view of the durable beliefs the agent has formed about you from your activity — the local second-brain memory. Retracting a claim hides it from your digests and future suggestions while preserving the record for transparency.

empty.noneDesc: A claim is a durable belief the agent forms about your work patterns — for example, "deep-work blocks cluster in the morning". None have accumulated yet; they build up as daily digests are generated.
empty.filteredDesc: No claims match the selected kind, status, and time range. Retracted claims are hidden unless you choose a status that includes them.

retract.confirmNote: Retracting hides this claim from your digests and future suggestions. The record is preserved (not deleted), so the change stays auditable.

aiUsage.description: Tokens your configured AI provider processed today, priced from a local reference table — no network lookup.
aiUsage.pricingUnknown: No local price entry for this model
aiUsage.todayOnlyNote: Today only; the counter resets when the app restarts or the day changes.

egress.title: Egress transparency
egress.description: A read-only record of what has left this device. Backed by the tamper-evident egress ledger, which is retained as compliance evidence even after you erase your data.
egress.captureBlockedBytesHint: A frame that was deliberately not captured — nothing was sent.

empty.ledgerTitle: Nothing has left this device yet
empty.ledgerDesc: The egress ledger is empty. When data is uploaded, synced, or a capture is blocked, an audit entry will appear here.
empty.rangeDesc: No egress entries match the selected time range and disposition filter.

monitoring.label: Activity monitoring
monitoring.description: Collect on-device context about your work so the agent can assist you. All data stays on your computer.

collected.ocrText: Extracted screen text (OCR) and text-region coordinates, stored with capture records for your retention period

clipboard.label: Clipboard and file access
clipboard.description: Higher-sensitivity, off by default. Turn this on only if you want clipboard and file-access activity included.

microphone.label: Microphone and voice
microphone.description: Higher-sensitivity, off by default. Turn this on only if you want voice capture (Voice-Activity continuous listening or push-to-talk) included.

collected.audioCapture: Microphone audio (continuous in Voice-Activity mode, or while you hold push-to-talk)
collected.transcript: A text transcript that enters your chat (the text is PII-masked)
collected.cloudEgress: If you configure cloud speech-to-text, your raw audio is sent to the endpoint you configure (default: OpenAI's API, US-based)

microphone.disclosure: Voice audio is captured (continuously in Voice-Activity mode, or while you hold push-to-talk) and transcribed to text that enters your chat (the text is PII-masked). If you enable cloud speech-to-text (Settings → Audio) AND configure an API key, your raw audio — not just the transcript — is sent to the speech-to-text endpoint you configure (default: OpenAI's API), unfiltered. Transcripts already sent persist in your chat history and are managed and erased there, not by this toggle.
microphone.osNote: Granting consent here does not grant the operating system's microphone permission. Both layers are required for voice capture to run — grant the OS microphone permission separately in Settings → Monitoring.

upgradeNotice.title: Microphone now needs its own consent
upgradeNotice.body: Voice input is paused. In this version the microphone has its own consent, separate from screen capture. Grant it on the Privacy page to resume voice capture.

fullText.label: AI text processing and external providers
fullText.description: Allow Maekon to process full text for AI features. When you choose an external AI provider, minimized and redacted text may leave this device.

collected.chatText: Text you explicitly submit in an AI chat
collected.activeContext: Minimized and redacted active-app context included with an AI request
collected.providerResult: The provider result returned to your Maekon session

fullText.disclosure: Off by default. Turn this on only if you consent to full-text AI processing and, when an external provider is configured, off-device transfer of minimized and redacted text. Provider configuration and privacy filtering still apply; this never authorizes raw screenshots, credentials, or excluded-app content.

ocrProcessing.label: OCR text processing
ocrProcessing.description: Allow Maekon to extract text from screen captures you already consented to. Processing stays on this device unless you separately configure an external OCR provider.
ocrProcessing.collectedTitle: When on, this processes and may retain locally:

collected.screenPixels: Pixels from captures already allowed by screen-capture consent
collected.extractedText: Extracted text and text-region coordinates used in local capture and scene context
collected.retention: OCR text stored with local capture records for your configured retention period

ocrProcessing.disclosure: This consent does not by itself allow raw screenshots to leave your device. External OCR also requires provider configuration; sending an unredacted screenshot requires the separate highest-sensitivity consent below. Turning this off blocks new OCR text in capture, scene-analysis, and provider paths. Use Withdraw consent or data deletion to erase previously retained records.
ocrProcessing.linuxUnsupported: OCR is not yet available on Linux — this consent takes effect once an engine ships for your platform.

unredactedExternalOcr.label: Unredacted external OCR
unredactedExternalOcr.description: Highest-sensitivity, off by default. Turn this on only if you intentionally allow raw screenshots to be sent to an external OCR provider.

collected.rawScreenImage: Raw screenshot image data before local PII masking
collected.windowContext: Safe decision metadata such as app name and title length
collected.providerResult: The external OCR provider's text result after processing

unredactedExternalOcr.disclosure: This consent is required in addition to OCR processing consent and the AI setting that allows unredacted external OCR. Without this explicit consent, raw off-device OCR is blocked even if the setting is enabled.

withdraw.label: Withdraw consent and delete data
withdraw.description: Withdrawing stops all collection and deletes data Maekon manages on this device. This is stronger than simply turning monitoring off.
withdraw.confirmMessage: All collection stops and Maekon deletes the data it manages on this device.
withdraw.confirmNote: Files you've already exported or backed up to disk are saved outside the app and are not removed by this action.

patternLearning.label: Pattern Learning & Coaching
patternLearning.description: Lets Maekon learn recurring work patterns locally to power focus playbooks and proactive coaching. Turning this off stops pattern learning; already-derived stats age out with normal retention.

collected.playbookSignals: Focus playbook signals derived from your activity

crossDeviceSync.label: Cross-Device Sync
crossDeviceSync.description: Allows syncing your Maekon data with your own paired devices over the local network. Turning this off stops new sync sessions; paired devices keep their existing copies.

collected.syncPayloads: Encrypted sync payloads to your paired devices

settingsAutomation.title: Automation
settingsAutomation.sandboxEnabledDescription: Execute commands in an isolated environment
settingsAutomation.sandboxProfileHint: Standard is the default for day-to-day automation. Use Strict for untrusted commands and Permissive only for local troubleshooting.
settingsAutomation.sandboxProfileWindowsHint: Windows currently runs only Permissive. Standard and Strict fail closed before execution because filesystem, syscall, and network containment are unavailable.
settingsAutomation.accessModeHint: This choice controls which provider setup fields become active below.
settingsAutomation.accessModeApiKeyDescription: Use direct HTTP endpoints for provider-hosted or self-hosted services. API keys are only required when the selected surface expects them.
settingsAutomation.accessModeCliDescription: Preferred for subscription-backed products. Maekon will guide users through installed provider-owned CLI flows.
settingsAutomation.accessModeOAuthDescription: Experimental managed OAuth path for supported provider surfaces. Prefer installed provider CLIs when available.
settingsAutomation.accessModeLocalDescription: On-device only — intent planning runs against a local Ollama server on this machine (rule-based fallback when Ollama is not running). Nothing leaves your device.
settingsAutomation.preferredCliDescription: Use {{surface}} when you want provider-managed auth and subscription entitlements to stay with the installed CLI.
settingsAutomation.placementDescriptionProviderHosted: Requests go to the provider's hosted service.
settingsAutomation.placementDescriptionSelfHosted: You operate this endpoint yourself, such as a local Ollama server.
settingsAutomation.placementDescriptionInstalledCli: Execution runs through a provider-owned CLI installed on this machine.
settingsAutomation.placementDescriptionCustomHosted: Requests go to a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint you manage or proxy.
settingsAutomation.ocrProviderHint: Keep OCR local unless remote OCR quality or a multimodal LLM surface is required.
settingsAutomation.ocrLocalUnavailableDescription: This build has no local OCR engine on this platform (native OCR is macOS/Windows-only, and the bundled Tesseract fallback is not compiled in). Local OCR would silently return zero results — switch to Remote OCR instead.
settingsAutomation.llmProviderHint: Remote LLMs can improve capability, but they also use the selected access path and external data policy.
settingsAutomation.cliModeProviderSummary: Provider CLI mode keeps OCR and LLM providers on local execution. Supported LLM workflows will use installed provider-owned CLIs through the selected surface.
settingsAutomation.oauthLlmProviderPinned: Managed OAuth currently requires the LLM provider to stay on Remote.
settingsAutomation.providerSelectionLockedCli: Installed provider CLI mode keeps the LLM provider fixed to Remote.
settingsAutomation.providerSelectionLockedOAuth: Managed OAuth keeps the LLM provider fixed to Remote.
settingsAutomation.activeRoutingDescription: These are the effective OCR and LLM paths the runtime will use right now.
settingsAutomation.dataPolicyHint: This policy is the last privacy gate before text, OCR, or model context can leave the device.
settingsAutomation.allowUnredactedExternalOcrDescription: Skip pre-upload PII blur for external OCR (higher quality, lower privacy).
settingsAutomation.sceneActionOverrideEnabledDescription: Temporarily permit sensitive scene typing with explicit reason, approver, and expiry.
settingsAutomation.sceneActionOverrideReasonHint: Use a concrete reason so future audit entries explain why sensitive input was allowed.
settingsAutomation.sceneActionOverrideReasonPlaceholder: Example: calibration for low-confidence OCR workflow
settingsAutomation.sceneActionOverrideExpiryHint: Short expiries reduce the chance of a temporary exception becoming the default.
settingsAutomation.sceneIntelligenceEnabledDescription: Enable OCR-based UI structure detection and assistant recommendations.
settingsAutomation.sceneOverlayEnabledDescription: Render detected UI element boxes on session replay screenshots.
settingsAutomation.sceneAllowExecutionDescription: Permit direct click/type execution from scene coordinates (RPA gate).
settingsAutomation.sceneMinConfidenceHint: Higher values reduce false targets but may hide usable controls in noisy screenshots.
settingsAutomation.sceneMaxElementsHint: Limit the element count so replay overlays and assistant prompts stay readable.
settingsAutomation.sceneCalibrationEnabledDescription: Validate whether current scene quality is sufficient before assistant usage.
settingsAutomation.sceneCalibrationMinElementsHint: Require enough detected controls before trusting the scene for assistant guidance.
settingsAutomation.sceneCalibrationMinAvgConfidenceHint: Use this as the quality bar for accepting a calibrated scene.
settingsAutomation.ocrValidationEnabledDescription: Filter low-confidence or invalid OCR results before downstream automation.
settingsAutomation.ocrMinConfidenceHint: Raise this when OCR noise causes incorrect downstream suggestions.
settingsAutomation.ocrMaxInvalidRatioHint: Lower values reject OCR batches with too many unusable tokens.
settingsAutomation.fallbackToLocalDescription: Fall back to local model when external API fails
settingsAutomation.ocrEndpointHint: Use the OCR endpoint expected by the selected provider surface.
settingsAutomation.llmEndpointHint: Use the LLM endpoint expected by the selected provider surface.
settingsAutomation.apiKeyHint: Keys should be stored through the configured secret backend, not pasted into notes or profiles.
settingsAutomation.apiKeyStoredHint: This secret is currently stored in {{backend}}. Enter a new key here to replace it.
settingsAutomation.noAuthSurfaceDescription: This surface does not require an API key. Leave the credential field empty and connect to the local or self-hosted endpoint directly.
settingsAutomation.secretProjectionEnabledDescription: Permit Maekon-managed CLI and bridge compatibility flows for this stored secret.
settingsAutomation.ocrModelHint: Prefer image-capable or vision API models for OCR surfaces.
settingsAutomation.llmModelHint: Choose a model compatible with the selected execution path.
settingsAutomation.modelSelectionUnsupportedSurface: This surface does not support selecting a model explicitly. Maekon will use the surface's built-in OCR or provider default path.
settingsAutomation.ocrModelUnsupported: The selected model is not known to support image-based OCR on this surface. Choose a compatible multimodal model.
settingsAutomation.ocrModelCompatibilityUnknown: Maekon could not confirm OCR compatibility for {{model}} on this surface. Use a known multimodal model or verify with model discovery before saving.
settingsAutomation.ocrModelCompatibilityUnknownRejected: Maekon requires a known OCR-compatible model for this surface. {{model}} is not catalogued yet, so choose a known multimodal model before saving.
settingsAutomation.llmModelUnsupported: The selected model is not known to support this LLM surface. Choose a compatible model for the selected execution path.
settingsAutomation.llmModelCompatibilityUnknown: Maekon could not confirm LLM compatibility for {{model}} on this surface. Verify the model or load the catalog before saving.
settingsAutomation.llmModelCompatibilityUnknownRejected: Maekon requires a known compatible LLM model for this surface. {{model}} is not catalogued yet, so choose a known supported model before saving.
settingsAutomation.selfHostedCustomEndpointStatus: This self-hosted surface is using a custom endpoint. Readiness was not probed for that endpoint, so verify the local server manually.
settingsAutomation.timeoutHint: Short timeouts fail fast; longer timeouts are useful for local or cold-started services.
settingsAutomation.providerSurfaceHint: Provider surfaces describe where execution runs, how auth works, and which prerequisites must be ready.
settingsAutomation.savedProfilesDescription: Save the full active AI provider setup and switch between profiles without rebuilding OCR, LLM, and policy settings by hand.
settingsAutomation.savedProfilesSelectHint: Selecting a profile restores its saved provider, routing, policy, and endpoint choices.
settingsAutomation.savedProfilesNameHint: Use names that describe the environment, such as local, staging, or production.
settingsAutomation.savedProfilesSelectedHint: You are editing {{name}}. Save settings to persist the current AI provider changes back into this profile.
settingsAutomation.savedProfilesCustomHint: The current AI provider setup is custom. Save it as a named profile to reuse it later.
settingsAutomation.profileNameRequired: Enter a profile name before saving.
settingsAutomation.noCompatibleProviderSurface: No compatible provider surface is available for this mode.
settingsAutomation.ocrStrategyMultimodal: This OCR surface runs through a multimodal model. Prefer image-capable models and verify compatibility before saving custom model IDs.
settingsAutomation.ocrStrategyVisionApi: This OCR surface runs through a dedicated vision API. Model selection may be limited or unavailable depending on the endpoint.
settingsAutomation.managedOAuthSurfaceDescription: This surface uses provider-managed OAuth. Maekon does not ask for an API key or editable endpoint here.
settingsAutomation.subprocessSurfaceDescription: This surface runs through an installed provider-owned CLI. Authentication and subscription entitlements stay with the provider CLI.
settingsAutomation.modelDiscoveryNoModels: No models were returned for this provider configuration.

active.title: Warming Up
active.description: Maekon is collecting activity data in the background. Open any app and keep working — your first metrics usually appear within a minute, and your first recovery card surfaces in the tracking panel at the top of your screen within about 15 minutes.

paused.title: Activity Capture Is Paused
paused.description: Maekon is not collecting activity data. Resume capture when you are ready to start building your dashboard.

consentRequired.title: Capture Consent Required
consentRequired.description: Maekon is not collecting activity data. Review and grant capture consent before starting collection.

unavailable.title: Activity Status Unavailable
unavailable.description: Maekon cannot confirm whether activity capture is running. Check the desktop app before relying on this dashboard.

timeline.title: Screenshot Capture Is Off
timeline.description: Turn on screenshot capture in Settings to build a visual timeline of your day. You can limit captures to specific apps later.

timelineWaiting.title: Capturing Your First Screenshots
timelineWaiting.description: Maekon captures the active window every few seconds. Frames should appear within 2–3 minutes after opening your first app. If nothing shows up after 5 minutes, check Screen Recording permission in Settings.

timelineStandalone.title: Desktop Capture Unavailable
timelineStandalone.description: The app is running without live desktop access. Reopen Maekon in live desktop mode, then come back to start capturing your activity.

reports.title: Building Your First Report
reports.description: Reports are generated once you've used any monitored app for a continuous hour. Come back after your first work session to see activity breakdowns.

focus.title: Learning Your Focus Patterns
focus.description: Your focus score is calculated from deep-work periods of 15 minutes or longer. Spend some uninterrupted time on any task and your first score will appear here.

replay.title: No Session Records
replay.description: No sessions were recorded in the selected period. Try a different date range or keep the app running to build new sessions.

automation.title: Automation Inactive
automation.description: Automation is turned off. Enable it in Settings to let Maekon run approved commands on your behalf.
automation.guideEnableDescription: Start from Settings so provider, sandbox, and privacy gates are configured together.
automation.guidePolicyDescription: Add narrow policies for trusted local processes before running presets.
automation.guideAuditDescription: Review execution history after the first command to confirm elapsed time and status.

auditLog.title: No Audit Entries
auditLog.description: Audit entries will appear once Maekon executes automation commands on your behalf.
auditLog.guideRunDescription: Entries are created after a preset or command passes policy checks and starts execution.
auditLog.guideFilterDescription: Filter by successful, failed, denied, or timed out runs when history starts filling in.
auditLog.guideElapsedDescription: Elapsed and p95 values help spot slow commands before they become workflow friction.

chat.title: Start a Conversation
chat.description: Ask Maekon about your work patterns, focus history, or how to improve your routine. Create a new session from the sidebar to begin.

playbooksCoaching.title: No Coaching Templates
playbooksCoaching.description: Coaching templates customize what Maekon says and when. New templates will appear here as you or your team add them.
playbooksCoaching.guideTriggerDescription: Start with one observable moment, such as a context switch, long session, or interruption.
playbooksCoaching.guideVariablesDescription: Template variables are shown as chips so it is clear what Maekon fills in at runtime.
playbooksCoaching.guidePreviewDescription: Review tone and variables before the template is used in live coaching.

playbooksPresets.title: No Automation Presets
playbooksPresets.description: Automation presets are ready-made workflows for common tasks. Install presets from the catalog or create your own in Settings.
playbooksPresets.guideReviewDescription: Start with commands you already run manually and keep the preset purpose narrow.
playbooksPresets.guidePolicyDescription: Presets should only run after matching execution policies and sandbox settings exist.
playbooksPresets.guideRunDescription: Use the Commands page to test a preset and confirm the audit entry after the run.

onboarding.step1Desc: Maekon monitors your desktop activity and provides intelligent suggestions to boost productivity.
onboarding.step2Desc: Maekon needs some permissions to work effectively.
onboarding.step2DescMac: Accessibility and Screen Recording are required to capture context reliably. Notifications are recommended for reminders and coaching, but they do not block setup.
onboarding.step2DescWindows: Windows usually does not require separate permission prompts, but Maekon still depends on desktop access, screen capture, and notification delivery being available.
onboarding.step2DescLinux: Linux usually relies on session services instead of OS prompts. Confirm accessibility, screen capture, and notifications are available in your desktop session.
onboarding.step2RequiredDesc: Grant Accessibility and Screen Recording before continuing.
onboarding.step2RequiredContinueHint: You can move on after the required macOS permissions show as enabled.
onboarding.step2ReadyDesc: Accessibility and Screen Recording are enabled. You can continue.
onboarding.step2ReadyInline: Accessibility and Screen Recording are enabled.
onboarding.step2ScreenCaptureRestartTitle: Restart Maekon after enabling Screen Recording
onboarding.step2ScreenCaptureRestartDesc: macOS may not apply newly granted Screen Recording access to the running app until Maekon is relaunched.
onboarding.step2PermissionCheckFailed: Could not read the current desktop permission state.
onboarding.step2SystemSettingsOpenFailed: Could not open macOS System Settings.
onboarding.step3Desc: Here's what Maekon can do for you.
onboarding.step4Desc: You're all set. Start using Maekon now.

autostart.title: Start Maekon automatically?

consent.title: Start monitoring
consent.description: Grant Maekon consent to collect on-device context so it can assist you. Everything stays on your computer, and you can withdraw consent anytime in Privacy settings.
consent.collectedTitle: When you start monitoring, Maekon collects:
consent.grantedNote: Maekon will start collecting on-device context. Manage or withdraw consent anytime in Privacy settings.
consent.osNote: Granting consent is separate from the OS screen-recording permission above — Maekon needs both to capture your screen.

coaching.title: Proactive Coaching
coaching.description: Maekon can watch your activity patterns and send nudges — overlay tips and desktop notifications — to help you stay on track. Everything is processed on-device only.

enablesList.item2: Desktop notifications for focus and goals

coaching.activeNote: Changes take effect immediately — no restart needed.

policies.title: Execution Policies
policies.emptyDescription: No commands are approved yet. Start with one local process, keep confirmation on, and review the first run before widening access.
policies.emptyStepProcessTitle: Start with one trusted local process

policies.emptyStepConfirmDesc: Confirm every run while validating the process, arguments, and audit output.
policies.emptyStepReviewDesc: Check execution history before loosening arguments, sandbox, or approval requirements.
policies.policyIdHint: Stable internal id, for example pol-git-status.
policies.processNameHint: Exact command or process name, for example git.
policies.allowedArgsHint: Leave empty only if every argument for this process should be allowed.

syncTab.title: Cross-Device Sync
syncTab.notEnabled: Sync is not enabled. To activate cross-device sync:

syncTab.step3: Choose a transport (File, Remote, or LAN) in sync settings
syncTab.noPeers: No peers discovered yet. Ensure other devices are on the same network with sync enabled.
syncTab.enableIntro: Choose a passphrase and enable sync. It is stored in your OS keychain (never in the config file) and is used to derive the end-to-end encryption key. All devices you sync must use the same passphrase.
syncTab.passphraseTooShort: Passphrase must be at least {{count}} characters.
syncTab.enableDone: Saved. Restart the app to activate sync.

syncTab.forgetPeerError: The peer could not be disconnected. Try again.

syncTab.uploadRecoveryInterrupted: Upload interrupted. {{count}} synthetic items remain local and unsent.
syncTab.uploadRecoveryRecovered: Upload recovered after {{attempts}} attempts and {{reprimes}} re-primes. The sent marker was written only after success.
syncTab.uploadRecoveryError: The synthetic recovery step could not be completed.

week.title: Weekly Digest
week.empty: No weekly digest yet. One is generated automatically each week once activity segments accumulate.

advancedTab.aiFeaturesMasterDescription: Turns on local embedding, AI semantic search, and the AI daily-digest narrative in one step — all processed on-device. Takes effect after you restart Maekon.
advancedTab.llmSummaryDescription: Use the on-device LLM to write a natural-language summary of your day (requires embedding). Takes effect after restart.
advancedTab.enableSuggestionsDescription: Receive AI-powered suggestions based on your activity
advancedTab.showBorderDescription: Display a colored border around the screen when monitoring
advancedTab.enableAnalysisDescription: Run LLM analysis on activity segments
advancedTab.embeddingDescription: Enable vector embedding for AI analysis context retrieval — does not power the Search page's Semantic mode
advancedTab.guiIntelligenceDescription: Detect and aggregate GUI interaction patterns
advancedTab.textIntelligenceDescription: Extract and classify text patterns from activity
advancedTab.autoTunerDescription: EMA-based drift detection and automatic re-clustering of behavioral regimes
advancedTab.tieredMemoryDescription: Builds day/week digests, recalibration segments, goal progress, and habit streaks from your activity. Runs locally.
advancedTab.tieredMemoryNeedsConsent: This pipeline also needs the “Pattern Learning & Coaching” consent, which is off by default. Grant it under Privacy → Data Controls — until then this switch has no effect.
advancedTab.tieredMemoryNeedsRestart: Takes effect at the next launch. The pipeline is wired at startup, so day/week digests, segments, goals, and habit streaks fill in from the launch after this setting was turned on.
advancedTab.grpcEnabledDescription: Use gRPC for server communication (requires server support)
advancedTab.enableCoachingDescription: Proactive productivity coaching and goal tracking
advancedTab.lanDiscoveryDescription: Advertise this device on the local network for peer sync
advancedTab.payloadCompressionDescription: Compress changeset payloads before encryption to reduce bandwidth
